summary: F1: IP 193.140.10.9 generated 71 failures across 68 accounts followed by one successful login, but Critic judged it shared egress noise due to 187 MFA logins from that IP in 30 days. F2: An OWA inbox forwarding rule to internal e.oz.archive@aegean.edu was assessed and determined not to be exfiltration. Risk Gate verdict: benign, confidence 0.75; no compromise signal survived.

risk.rationale: No surviving verified findings exist for case-005. Both suspicious signals were rejected with explicit justification: the 193.140.10.9 activity is attributed to shared egress with 187 distinct MFA completions (above the 10 threshold) and broad failure noise rather than a coordinated password spray; the OWA forwarding rule targets an internal @aegean.edu archive address, not external exfiltration.
